changes: All 225 programs of the Midiverb, Midiverb II and Midifex are in: the 31 that needed more DSP time are back.
New: the Midiverb II's chorus and flange programs (50-69), sweeping with the LFOs its own controller computed.
PROG now shows the original's program numbers (1-63 on MV1 and FEX, 1-99 on MV2), so a project saved with 0.1.0 may play a different program.
Known issue: the triggered flanges (50, 53 and 57) sweep on their own; nothing triggers them.
Known issue: the chorus and flange speeds follow an assumed pace, not one measured on a real Midiverb II.
First release: 174 programs of the Alesis Midiverb, Midiverb II and Midifex on FX2, played at the originals' own arithmetic.
PROG picks the program and BANK the unit; a message box names each as you turn. STOP, STOP, STOP cuts the tail.
Known issue: on base 0.8.1 the first NO after picking it only closes the memory box; press FX2 for its page instead.
Known issue: the Midiverb II's chorus and flange programs, and 31 programs that need more DSP time, are not in this release.
